newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices steady to mostly lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices steady to mostly lower.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices remained steady to mostly lower on Wednesday in quiet activity, dealers said.
But with the cold weather coming on in November and December, dealers expect spot millfeed demand to improve.

"It is very quiet," a Buffalo dealer said. "Although we do not see a great deal of change in production on the supply side, demand is (also) quiet, so we are finding things a little bit dead in the water."
Buffalo spot values dropped $2 to bid at $87.00 a ton and to offer at $89.00 a ton.
He noted that corn had an effect on the millfeed market due to the fact there is more corn at lower prices than three and four weeks ago.
"Certainly it (corn) is displacing some of the other ingredients and formulass because it is now more available in the new crop," he said.
